desc:
🌊 SUBMERGED [BETA] 🌊
Crew a submarine into the deep. Something down there knows you're coming. 👁️

🚢 Unlock submarines
🔧 Fix leaks, man the guns, swim out in a diving suit
🦑 Fight sea monsters or run away from them!
⬇️ Dive super deep through layers!
👥 Play with friends or an NPC crew

⚠️ Early beta: expect bugs! This is the earliest version yet. There is so much more to come. Please report bugs if you find any!

Inspired by: UBOAT, Subnautica, Iron Lung, and Barotrauma.

Categories: horror, scary, submarine, deep sea, ocean, underwater, co-op, teamwork, friends, survival, monsters, sea monster, leviathan, thalassophobia, diving, exploration, crew, boss fight, upgrades, jumpscare
